units.source_text: 不过，对于贫穷的这种憎恨，并没有丝毫改变。

en.t: Still, his hatred of poverty had not changed in the slightest.

units.source_text: 陈旧的榻榻米、昏暗的灯光、纸门上斑驳脱落的常春藤话貌，这一切代表着家里寒酸的样子都使他感到憎恨。

en.t: The old tatami mats, the dim light, the patchy, peeling ivy on the paper doors, everything that represented the shabby poverty of his home filled him with hatred.

units.source_text: 他甚至因为寒酸的生活，憎恨自己的父母。

en.t: Because of that shabby life, he even hated his own parents.

units.source_text: 尤其是那个比他还矮的秃头父亲。

en.t: Especially his bald father, who was even shorter than he was.

units.source_text: 父亲常常来学校参加保证人会议，信辅对出现在同学面前的父亲感觉羞耻。

en.t: His father often came to the school to attend guarantor meetings, and Shinsuke felt ashamed of him when he appeared before his classmates.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他对于自己瞧不起自己的亲生父亲的这种自卑心里感觉羞耻。

en.t: At the same time, he was ashamed of the inferiority within himself that made him look down on his own father.

units.source_text: 他模仿国木独步写了一段《不自欺记》，如今写着这段话的稿纸已经泛黄——

en.t: Imitating Kunikida Doppo, he wrote a passage called An Account of Not Deceiving Myself, and by now the manuscript paper bearing those words had already yellowed.
